From: Alex Barnes <alex@logiva.com>

Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot run blocked — asking for short runway/top-up

Hi Marissa,

We're excited about the pilot, but we've hit a blocker integrating Logiva's document ingestion pipeline with Redwood's connector. The root cause is an upstream schema enforcement change in our parser that surfaced this morning — it means our QA team needs an extra week to add a compatibility shim and re-run sample loads.

Given the timeline shift, can we request a small trial top-up or a 10-day extension on the sandbox? Without the extra runway our SREs won't be able to complete end-to-end verification before our leadership demo on Oct 15.

I've attached the integration trace and a short summary of the failing step. Happy to jump on a quick call — ETA for our fix is ~Oct 8 if nothing else pops up.

Thanks,
Alex Barnes
Dir. of Integrations, Logiva

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for attaching the trace. Sorry to hear about the parser change; we see similar surprises more than we'd like.

We can absolutely help keep the pilot moving. Two immediate options:
- Add a 10-day sandbox extension on your existing pilot + 1000 free eval credits so your engineers can run through the verification window, or
- Keep the current end date but provision a short-term dedicated staging slot for your test runs (this costs extra but gives guaranteed throughput).

I recommend the first option given your timeline. I need a quick sign-off from our pricing/operations team for the credit top-up — looping in Karthik to approve. Can you confirm the exact date you'd like the sandbox extended to and whether the team needs any additional IP allowlist entries?

I'll also attach the mutual action plan template so we capture responsibilities and target dates.

Best,
Marissa Cole
